Name: Wizard's Alchemy Table
Author: xuyaoXmod
Description:
[heading]Description（简介）[/heading]
[quote]Wizard's Alchemy Table brings Minecraft's [b]Equivalent Exchange (ProjectE)[/b] idea to Stardew Valley: an [b]EMC transmutation table[/b] where every item has a value, and value can be turned back into items.
Store something in the table and it becomes [b]EMC[/b]. Withdraw anything you have already recorded and it costs exactly the same EMC — [b]1:1, no tax, no loss[/b]. There is no stock to manage: once something has been stored, it can be pulled back out forever.
Values are derived from the game itself, so [b]modded items just work[/b]: anything with a sell price is worth that price; anything with a crafting recipe (furniture, furnaces, chests, fences, machines…) is worth the [b]total worth of its materials ÷ how many the recipe produces[/b]; cooked food is worth its ingredients (category ingredients use the cheapest item in that category, so cooking can never print EMC).
Getting the table is the goal, not the grind: befriend the [b]Wizard[/b], and once you have 10 hearts he opens a rune-circle pact where you pay [b]1,000,000g, 100 gold-quality starfruit and 100 iridium bars[/b] — all four costs are GMCM sliders (0 … original).[/quote][heading]Installation instructions（安装步骤）[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] (smapi.io).[/*]
[*]Download and [b]unzip[/b].[/*]
[*]Copy the 
[code]WitchAlchemyTable[/code] folder into 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] → you should have 
[code]Mods/WitchAlchemyTable/manifest.json[/code].[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to change pact costs with sliders.[/*]
[*]Launch the game [b]through SMAPI[/b]; the console shows 
[code]法师的炼金台 1.3.0 by DSH[/code].[/*]
[/list]In game: 10 hearts with the [b]Wizard[/b] → talk to him with an [b]empty hand[/b] → pay → place the table (furniture) → [b]right-click[/b] it. To update: replace the folder, keep your save (EMC is stored in the save file).
[heading]Main features（核心特性）[/heading]
[list]
[*]EMC for [b]everything sellable[/b], mod items included, quality counted, profession bonuses excluded.[/*]
[*][b]Craftable items by material value[/b] (÷ produced count) — 269 recipes indexed in 1.3.0.[/*]
[*][b]Cooking included[/b] — food priced by ingredients; category ingredients use the cheapest match; unpriceable ingredients count as free instead of breaking the recipe.[/*]
[*][b]1:1 conversion, no tax, no loss[/b] — whole stack / single deposit, withdraw 1 / 10 / stack.[/*]
[*][b]All / Crafted / Sold[/b] filter tabs in the transmutation UI.[/*]
[*][b]Rune-circle pact with the Wizard[/b] — his vanilla story, schedules, festivals and heart events untouched.[/*]
[*][b]All costs adjustable[/b] via GMCM sliders (hearts, gold, starfruit, iridium; 0 … original).[/*]
[*][b]Bilingual[/b] EN/中文, UI scales to small windows.[/*]
[*][b]Safe by design[/b]: tools, quest items and the table itself can't be converted; no recipe allows farming infinite EMC.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements（前置）[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/b] (tested 1.6.15)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] (tested 4.5.2)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16+[/b] — [i]optional[/i], only for in-game sliders[/*]
[*]No other mods required; item-adding mods are supported automatically[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] EMC stored per player, host writes the save[/*]
